description: The retrospective reality-check for an existing account — triage ~90 days of content into keep/kill/refresh, map pillar coverage, catch voice drift, and fix profile fundamentals, then turn it into a roadmap. Uses the AUDIT framework. Reads brand-profile + content-pillars + social-strategy (the plan) and analytics-and-reporting (the data) first. It reads native analytics (WoopSocial has none), scores on signal not vanity, recommends rather than auto-deletes, and never fabricates. Feeds content-recycling, content-pillars, profile-optimization, voice-builder, and social-strategy.

evals.name: activity_not_progress_triage
evals.input: Can you audit my account? I post all the time but I'm not sure it's working.
evals.context: brand-profile, content-pillars, social-strategy, and analytics-and-reporting exist.
expect: Names the core idea: posting consistently isn't the same as progress; the audit finds the signal under the busy-ness
Frames it as a retrospective reality-check that produces a keep/kill/refresh triage
Introduces the AUDIT framework (Assemble inventory, Uncover the signal, Diagnose pillars/voice/profile, Iterate keep/kill/refresh, Turn into a roadmap)
Reads the plan (content-pillars, social-strategy) it's auditing against and the analytics data source first

evals.name: reads_plan_and_analytics_first
evals.input: Tell me what to change about my content.
expect: Pulls the stated plan (content-pillars + social-strategy) to audit actual output against it
Sources performance from analytics-and-reporting / native analytics rather than guessing
Uses a ~90-day window (3-6 months) of output
Produces specific findings tied to that plan, not generic advice

evals.name: signal_not_vanity_scoring
evals.input: Rank my posts from best to worst.
expect: Scores on signal metrics (saves, shares, replies, plus the goal-mapped KPI) rather than likes/impressions/followers
Surfaces top and bottom performers AND the patterns behind them (by format, posting time, pillar)
Pulls the numbers via analytics-and-reporting / native analytics
Notes a high-like post can be low-value and vice versa — judge by the goal

evals.name: pillar_voice_profile_diagnosis
evals.input: What's actually wrong with my content?
expect: Maps output to content pillars to find over- and under-served pillars / whitespace (-> content-pillars)
Checks voice drift BOTH ways: content drifted off-brand, OR well-performing posts signal the brand voice should evolve (-> voice-builder)
Audits profile fundamentals (bio clarity/keywords, working links, pinned/featured posts, handle/visual consistency, native formats) (-> profile-optimization)
Flags cross-posted non-native content as a refresh/kill candidate

evals.name: pushback_on_auto_delete_and_vanity_kills
evals.input: Just auto-delete every post under 100 likes and mass-remove all my low content, and assume the topic gaps are fine.
expect: Refuses to auto-delete and to use likes as the kill criterion (low likes != low value — check saves/shares and the goal first)
Notes deleting can destroy evergreen/SEO value and engagement history; a human decides kills, and refresh is tried before kill
Refuses to assume gaps are fine or fabricate the coverage analysis — it must be mapped from real output
Reframes to a signal-based keep/kill/refresh triage the user approves

evals.name: edge_case_thin_data_new_account
evals.input: Audit my 3-week-old account — I've got 12 posts.
expect: Explains there's too little data for a reliable performance audit (small samples mislead)
Shifts to a STRUCTURAL/qualitative audit: profile fundamentals, pillar coverage, voice consistency, native-format use, and cadence
Recommends establishing a baseline and revisiting the performance triage at ~90 days (ties to goals-and-kpis / analytics-and-reporting)
Avoids keep/kill calls that need performance data

evals.name: honest_scope_reads_recommends_not_fabricates
evals.input: Pull my numbers and clean up my account for me.
expect: States the audit reads native analytics (WoopSocial has none) and interprets the numbers the user provides — never fabricated
Produces a keep/kill/refresh roadmap with quick wins vs long-term, but recommends rather than auto-executing
Notes the human executes deletions and that some profile edits happen natively in-app
Ensures the audit becomes an action plan (owners/timeline), not a spreadsheet graveyard

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just analytics-and-reporting or competitor-analysis or social-strategy?
expect: Distinguishes content-audit (periodic retrospective triage of YOUR existing account: keep/kill/refresh + pillars/voice/profile) from analytics-and-reporting (ongoing measurement, the data source)
Distinguishes it from competitor-analysis (rivals' public side) and social-strategy (the forward plan the audit informs)
Notes it feeds content-recycling, content-pillars, profile-optimization, and voice-builder with its findings
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
